headline:
hashrate *up 15%*.

panes.title: BOTH SET TO 100 AT THE ANCHOR
panes.sub: hashrate against what a block pays

post.x: kaspa's hashrate is up 15% against 6 weeks ago. over the same days the block reward fell 5.61%, as it does every month by design. more machines securing the chain, less new supply paying for them. that gap is the whole security question.
post.reply: the schedule behind the reward is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. we report the movement, never the motive.
